basic_details.job_title: DHAS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for 16 Senior Resident Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan (DHAS Delhi) has officially announced the Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 with 16 openings. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://health.delhi.gov.in/. Candidates who are not more than 45 years of age (General category) and hold an MBBS degree along with a Post Graduate Degree, Diploma, or DNB in the relevant specialty are eligible to attend the walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 03 August 2026. Direct links to download the official notification and view the walk-in interview details are available

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for General category candidates. Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 5 years extra for Persons with disabilities (Divyangjan).

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the DHAS Delhi Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download DHAS Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 16 vacancies are available – 5 for Anaesthesia, 1 for Obs & Gynae, 2 for Ophthalmology, 2 for Pediatrics, 1 for Medicine, 1 for Dermatology, and 4 for Radiology.

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MBBS with post graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institution. Must have valid registration with Delhi Medical Council. Candidates must not have completed 03 years Senior Residency in any recognized institution including regular and ad-hoc period. In case of non-availability of PG candidates, minimum 03 years experience in concerned specialty may be considered.

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for General category candidates. Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 5 years extra for Persons with disabilities (Divyangjan).

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Pay Matrix: Level 11 Salary Range: Rs.67,700 to Rs.2,08,700/- per month plus allowances as admissible under the rules.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required. Interested candidates may report for registration at 09:30 AM till 11:30 AM in the Establishment Branch along with photograph, photocopies of qualifying certificates, date of birth proof, Photo ID card and address proof. Only those candidates whose registration is completed by 11:30 AM shall be eligible for appearing before interview board. The interviews will be held thereafter. All original certificates must be brought for verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Resident posts at DHAS Delhi?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report for registration on 03 August 2026 between 09:30 AM and 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a post-graduate Degree, Diploma, or DNB in the concerned specialty from a recognized University or Institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for General category candidates is 45 years, with relaxations applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and Persons with Disabilities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary as per Pay Matrix Level 11, ranging from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700/- per month, plus admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts across various specialities.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their photograph, photocopies of qualifying certificates, date of birth proof, Photo ID card, and address proof for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is prior experience required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must not have completed 03 years of Senior Residency. In case of non-availability of PG candidates, a minimum of 03 years of experience in the concerned specialty may be considered.

faq.question: Q9. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Establishment Branch of Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
